{{nihongo|'''Ikishiro Shrine'''|印岐志呂神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Ikishiro Shrine''' (いきしろじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in Kataoka-chō, {{ill|Kusatsu, Shiga|Q386677|qid=Q386677}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}.

=== Enshrined Deities ===
* {{ill|Ōkuninushi|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q276944}}
* {{ill|Kuni-no-Tokotachi|qid=Q478504|lt=Kunitokotachi-no-Mikoto}}

=== History ===
It is said to have been founded during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Tenji|Q314802|qid=Q314802}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} listed in the Jinmyōchō of the {{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}}. According to shrine tradition, it received the divine rank of Senior Sixth Rank in the first year of {{ill|Ninju|Q1373077|qid=Q1373077}}. During the {{ill|Kenmu Disturbance|Q11486475|qid=Q11486475}}, in the 3rd year of {{ill|Kenmu|Q1193970|qid=Q1193970|lt=Kenmu}}, it became a battlefield during clashes between {{ill|Ogasawara Sadamune|Q7079835|qid=Q7079835}} of the Ashikaga faction and the forces of Mount Hiei and {{ill|Nitta Yoshisada|Q1328796|qid=Q1328796}} of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kenmu government}} ({{ill|Battle of Omi|Q65284013|qid=Q65284013}}). It was also the site of battles during {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|Q171411|qid=Q171411}}’s campaigns against the {{ill|Rokkaku clan|Q2975342|qid=Q2975342}}, among other conflicts, and was repeatedly exposed to warfare. In the 9th year of {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}}, it was designated a village shrine, and in the 6th year of {{ill|Taishō era|ar|فترة تايشو|br|Oadvezh Taishō|ca|Període Taishō|cs|Období Taišó|de|Taishō-Zeit|eo|Taiŝo-epoko|es|Era Taishō|et|Taishō ajastu|eu|Taishō aroa|fa|دوره تایشو|fi|Taishō-kausi|fr|Ère Taishō|he|תקופת טאישו|hi|ताइशो युग|hu|Taisó-kor|hy|Տայսյո|id|Zaman Taishō|it|Periodo Taishō|ja|大正|ko|다이쇼 시대|lt|Taišio laikotarpis|lv|Taišo periods|ml|തായ്ഷോ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Taishō|nl|Taishoperiode|no|Taishō-perioden|pl|Taishō (okres)|pt|Período Taishō|ro|Perioada Taishō|ru|Тайсё|sh|Taishō period|simple|Taishō era|sr|Таишо период|sv|Taishō|th|ยุคไทโช|tl|Panahong Taishō|tr|Taişo Dönemi|uk|Період Тайсьо|uz|Taishō davri|vi|Thời kỳ Đại Chính|zh|大正|zh_classical|大正 (年號)|zh_min_nan|Tāi-chèng|zh_yue|大正 (日本年號)|qid=Q329174}}, it was elevated to a prefectural shrine.
